description: This source file defines the FileInputDStream class in Apache Spark Streaming, which monitors a Hadoop-compatible filesystem for new files and creates a stream of data from them. It includes methods for finding new files, filtering based on modification times, and checkpointing.

classes.name: FileInputDStream
classes.description: A class that monitors a directory in Hadoop filesystem for new files and creates a streaming RDD from them, with checkpointing and file filtering capabilities.

classes.name: FileInputDStreamCheckpointData
classes.description: A checkpoint data class for FileInputDStream that stores the list of files processed at each batch time.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Finds new files since last check and creates an RDD from them.

methods.name: clearMetadata
methods.description: Removes old batch file info from memory.

methods.name: findNewFiles
methods.description: Identifies new files based on modification time and filters.

methods.name: isNewFile
methods.description: Determines if a file is new based on filter, mod time, and recent history.

methods.name: filesToRDD
methods.description: Creates an RDD from a list of file paths.

methods.name: directoryPath
methods.description: Returns the Path object for the monitored directory.

methods.name: fs
methods.description: Returns the Hadoop FileSystem object for the directory.

methods.name: readObject
methods.description: Custom deserialization method to restore transient fields.
